title: Coordinated launch timeline for Model Router: cross-channel announcement & webinar orchestration
creator: Alex Chen
description: Coordinate announcement across blog, email, social, and webinar for the Model Router launch. Create timeline, align stakeholders, draft assets, finalize release notes, schedule rehearsals, and handle cross-team approvals and tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Blog post published and promoted; Email campaign scheduled and QA'd; Social assets posted across primary channels; Webinar scheduled and rehearsed; Release notes final and published; Support and analytics runbook distributed.
activity_log: 2025-03-12: Kickoff with COMMS, ENG, DESIGN, DEVREL. Agreed on launch date 2025-04-08 and high-level responsibilities.
2025-03-13: Draft blog outline created; ENG provided baseline latency & cost numbers; design assigned hero illustration (DES-407).
2025-03-15: Release notes template started; requested APIs and changelog entries from runtime team (ENG-3312).
2025-03-18: Blog draft v1 reviewed by Marcus; feedback on wording for performance claims and example prompts.
2025-03-20: Legal requested removal of comparative claims; updated blog and release notes to remove competitor comparisons and add citations.
open_questions: Final webinar title? Options: 'Scaling Inference with Model Router' vs 'Model Router: Routing, Cost & Reliability'
Offer early access promo code for Dedicated customers?
Confirm webinar platform (Zoom Webinar vs Crowdcast)?
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Last-minute latency regression discovered - Mitigation: delay promotion and include transparent note in blog; run canary validation on staging.
Risk: Webinar speaker cancellation - Mitigation: secondary speaker (Marcus) on standby and prerecorded demo available.
Risk: Email templating issue across ESP - Mitigation: QA in staging and include fallback plain-text email.
notes_for_ops: Ensure CDN cache purge window scheduled at 09:00 UTC on launch day
Support rota: DevRel + SRE on-call 2 hours pre and 6 hours post-launch
Analytics tracking: UTM parameters for all channels; event 'model_router_launch' instrumented
post_launch_plan: Survey attendees with NPS + feature interest
Iterate on release notes for patch updates
